items.content_html: A lightweight utility for Node.js projects that accumulates items into fixed-size batches per key, preserving insertion order within each key. items.content_html: Grade Insight is a lightweight web app for uploading and analyzing student grade data from CSV files. The goal is to simplify grading transparency and support informed academic decisions.
